QUOTE: "The handlers all extend `ServerDataOperatorBase`, so they share its helpers." and "`ServerDataOperatorBase.execute` ... `this.batchRecords(models, description)`... The write itself is `BaseDataOperator.batchRecords`"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says handlers extend ServerDataOperatorBase and that most writes go through execute→batchRecords, but it explicitly says writes reach it "in two ways" rather than concluding every handler's writes go through the inherited `batchRecords`. It also doesn't tie that to the mixin constraint.
